text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, aztreonam 1 g injection is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 261 vials (19.8 days at 13.2 vials/day). Corvale General holds 255 vials (16.5 days at 15.4 vials/day). Corvale Lakeside holds 42 vials (10.1 days at 4.1 vials/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include aztreonam as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers all sites for 10 to 20 days. No national shortage is declared. Supply risk is local if usage increases or deliveries delay.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C. (Bristol‑Myers Squibb Princeton plant) as primary alternate; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer qualifies Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as secondary alternate (plant last VAI 2023-10-13); requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer evaluates Hospira, Inc. as third alternate pending plant verification; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer monitors daily usage at each site and triggers reorder at 14 days on hand; requires buyer approval.
5. Pharmacy director reviews alternate contracts and pricing; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Do not initiate therapeutic substitutions or rationing. Clinical changes remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
